fieldValues.title: Work committed straight to main is checked only after it lands, so main stays red
fieldValues.statement: Everyone who builds on muDemocracy.org needs a green main to judge their change against. Corpus work committed straight to main ("committed as found") and routine commits are checked only after they land; when they fail the coherence gate, main stays red, and every later change inherits the failure, so no gate can say whether that change is good.
